<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="37" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">Degree mask / strict autoregressive topology  |  Operators & tensor flow</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">static module / explicit profile  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="357.0" y="1496" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f8d4e1" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="380.0" y="1509" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="380.0" dy="0">Inputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="542.0" y="1496" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffddb3" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="565.0" y="1509" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="565.0" dy="0">Module</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="727.0" y="1496" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="750.0" y="1509" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="750.0" dy="0">Reshape</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="912.0" y="1496" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="935.0" y="1509" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="935.0" dy="0">Outputs</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="1537" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">Bottom-to-top; independent outputs are parallel, never an implicit tensor chain</tspan>
<tspan x="717.0" dy="16.52">Colors denote roles; Parameter / buffer / ordinary state are recorded separately in IR</tspan>
<tspan x="717.0" dy="16.52">Fixed source symbols + explicit profile; library operators are call boundaries</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="1641" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="1671" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="1696" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
